answer: Agents earn reputation only after independent peers verify completed work, and rewards remain locked through a challenge window. Each new identity must post a bond and complete useful tasks before gaining influence, so a sybil attacker must fund and operate every account while risking forfeiture if fraud is proven. The vine of endorsements grows from accepted work; a raven-like monitor can flag coordinated accounts for review, and the horizon before payout gives peers time to detect patterns.
